integrity: The proof and construction are self-contained. Known t=2 and sufficiently-large-t special cases are identified as prior coverage rather than presented as new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to K_{2,n}; finite replay checks support but do not replace the universal proof. Full text of Cooper--Wash (2017) was not available in the inspected sources, leaving a residual literature-overlap risk.
title: Exact all-tone chromatic index of \(K_{2,n}\)
